content.value_statement: Paid campaign changes are difficult to judge when windows, controls, and attribution settings differ. This skill structures evidence and returns a clear readback decision.
actual_capabilities: Defines a fixed readback window after the campaign leaves its learning phase.
Compares candidate performance with a control using ROAS or CPA.
Returns Promote, Keep-testing, Rollback, or Unproven with supporting evidence.
Normalizes conversion lag, attribution windows, and currencies before comparison.
Labels figures as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Delegates ratio calculations and statistical evidence to referenced helper skills.
limitations: Requires campaign, analytics, or ecommerce exports supplied from the user's own accounts.
Returns Unproven when no suitable control exists.
Does not perform the ROAS or CPA arithmetic itself.
Cannot validate outcomes when tracking is broken or conversions are double-counted.

use_cases.title: Review a budget increase
use_cases.description: Compare a changed campaign with an unchanged control after the learning phase and fixed readback window.

use_cases.title: Assess a creative rotation
use_cases.description: Measure a new creative against a sibling ad set and decide whether to promote, continue, or roll back.

use_cases.title: Normalize platform results
use_cases.description: Align currencies and attribution windows before comparing exported ROAS across advertising platforms.

prompt_templates.title: Read back one campaign change
prompt_templates.prompt: Assess [campaign change] over [candidate dates] against [control]. Use the attached export and return one readback decision with the ROAS or CPA delta.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review with one campaign and one control

prompt_templates.title: Evaluate a creative test
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the creative change made on [date]. Confirm learning ended, compare it with [control], and explain whether to promote, keep testing, roll back, or mark unproven.

prompt_templates.title: Compare platforms consistently
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare the attached Meta and Google exports. Normalize [currencies] and [attribution windows], account for conversion lag, and report controlled ROAS evidence with caveats.

prompt_templates.title: Run a governed measurement readback
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a fixed-window readback for [change]. Check tracking integrity, use [control], delegate calculations, apply the decision bar, and prepare a save-ready handoff summary.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced audit with measurement safeguards and handoff

output_examples.input: Budget increased on Campaign X fourteen days ago. The export includes Campaign X and an unchanged sibling campaign.
output_examples.output: Decision: Keep-testing. Campaign X improved ROAS versus the control, but the observed effect does not yet clear the decision bar. Read again in seven days.

output_examples.input: New prospecting creative launched after learning ended. CPA rose while the unchanged control remained stable.
output_examples.output: Decision: Rollback. Candidate CPA worsened against the control over the fixed window. Confirm attribution settings before applying the change.

output_examples.input: Meta and Google exports use different currencies and attribution windows.
output_examples.output: Decision: Unproven. The current ROAS values are not comparable. Normalize currency and attribution windows, then repeat the controlled readback.

best_practices: Choose the control and decision threshold before reading campaign results.
Wait until learning ends and conversion lag is represented in the window.
Keep measured values separate from estimates and causal explanations.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a raw before-and-after comparison as causal evidence.
Do not compare platform ROAS before normalizing attribution windows and currencies.
Do not promote a change when tracking is broken or conversions are duplicated.

faq.question: What data does this skill require?
faq.answer: Provide campaign exports and the change date. Analytics or ecommerce exports improve independent conversion and revenue checks.

faq.question: Does it connect directly to ad platforms?
faq.answer: No direct connection is required. The skill primarily uses files exported from accounts you control.

faq.question: How does it choose a verdict?
faq.answer: It compares the primary metric against a control and a preselected decision bar over a fixed window.

faq.question: What happens without a control?
faq.answer: The result is marked Unproven because a simple before-and-after change cannot establish the campaign effect.

faq.question: Can it compare Meta and Google ROAS?
faq.answer: Yes, after currency, attribution windows, and conversion lag are normalized.

faq.question: Does it calculate ROAS and CPA?
faq.answer: It delegates those calculations to the referenced ROI calculator and owns the measurement window, control, and final decision.
